subject.title: Integrar API real de puntos SEUR PUDO y selección de punto por el vendedor (BL-shipping-pudo-supply-02)

question: Should the team resume SEUR PUDO for Supply now, and if so what seller UI plus public API contract should carry the selected pickup point?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the implementation boundary depends on product timing, external SEUR API behavior, and the end-to-end seller checkout contract.

options.title: Keep as coordinated feature
options.body: Leave this issue open for Supply/Integrations to define the API/UI contract and land the full SEUR-backed flow together.

options.title: Narrow to backend first
options.body: Split a smaller backend-only task for real SEUR point lookup while deferring seller selection UI and activation.

options.title: Defer or abandon the flow
options.body: Close or relabel only if maintainers decide the non-production SEUR PUDO Supply flow will not be resumed.

recommendation.title: Keep as coordinated feature
